items: Filter Sports by league, and your team's match is Now's main card on matchday.
Channels with sound but no picture switch to the compatibility player by themselves.
Faster: Now and Sports open with matches straight away, and the app does less on mobile data.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
